rows.text: A dual axle records four tire pressures, so it needs four verdicts. Each value carries its own: a dropdown attached to the input it judges, so left outer can be Not OK while left inner is OK. That grid is the whole record: no status column, no per-row legend, no axle roll-up badge, no counters. Colour lives on the value that earned it and on the control you press. A tire in the top view takes the worst verdict entered for it so far and stays grey until one arrives; nothing is ever auto-filled. Switching Single / Dual asks nothing; typed values come back if you switch back. Marking OK in bulk exists at three levels: the inspection row, the section row, and every field's own card header, whatever its type. Mark all OK, Mark section OK and Mark field OK are the same quiet action on the same right edge, so the level is read from the row it sits on rather than from the label. Each fills only what is still Not inspected, never overwrites a verdict already picked, and never writes a value.
